visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female creator with light pink-toned hair sits in a salon chair wearing a black hairdressing cape. A stylist with dark hair tied back applies pink dye to her roots using a brush. The room is brightly lit with warm interior lighting and wooden decor. (2) A wide panning shot shows the salon interior, featuring several golden-framed oval mirrors and dark leather chairs in a row. The environment is clean and professional with tiled floors. (3) The creator is shown in a hair-washing station, lying back while the stylist rinses her hair with a showerhead. The lighting here is dimmer with dark green walls. (4) The screen displays a digital menu in Japanese and the stylist's Instagram page, showing various short-hair portraits. Text overlays indicate the salon's name and the creator's choice of professional. (5) The creator poses for 'Before' shots with light blonde hair and then 'After' shots showing her new vibrant pinkish-purple short bob. She smiles and touches her face, looking into the camera in a mirrored room. (6) The creator stands outdoors in a fuzzy white vest over a black turtleneck, holding a white shopping bag. The video concludes with a shot of her in a sunny park alongside a man and a small child.
